idea: Themed weeks, Money day: written from the source, then corrected by two independent editors before voicing.
description: At end-March 2025 Tamil Nadu had 13,204 bank offices, 16% more than Karnataka's 11,395, and a bigger share of India's bank loans (9.4% against 7.3%). Karnataka held 29% more deposits: 8.1% of India's against Tamil Nadu's 6.2%.

Per office, that is ₹166 crore of deposits in Karnataka and ₹111 crore in Tamil Nadu. Scheduled commercial banks. A deposit is counted where the bank office is, not where the saver lives. State totals, not per person. The table shows how much, not why.
source: Reserve Bank of India, Handbook of Statistics on Indian States 2024-25 (December 2025), Tables 152, 155 and 156: offices of scheduled commercial banks, their deposits and the credit used in each state, as at end-March 2025. Shares are of the all-India rows. A deposit is counted where the bank office is. State totals, not per person.
